results.title: Round-Robin Tournament Schedule
results.prompt: Four teams (A, B, C, D) play 3 rounds. Each team plays once per round. Team A cannot play Team B in Round 1. Team C plays Team D in Round 2. Construct the valid schedule.
results.reply:
To build this out, we need to ensure every team has a unique opponent each round while respecting your constraints. Here is a valid schedule for the three rounds:

Round 1: Team A plays Team C, Team B plays Team D.
Round 2: Team C plays Team D, Team A plays Team B.
Round 3: Team A plays Team D, Team B plays Team C.
